protocol.description:
WinFusion private protocol for compositor-allocated AHardwareBuffers.
The compositor allocates the AHardwareBuffer, sends its handle through the socket supplied by the client, and imports the same buffer as an EGLImage. The compositor reports the AHardwareBuffer's gralloc modifier and plane layout, and the client imports its backing dma-buf into Vulkan, so both sides use the same allocation and modifier.
This is the Android equivalent of zwp_linux_dmabuf_v1: it exists because Android EGL does not expose EGL_EXT_image_dma_buf_import.

interface.name: zwp_winfusion_buffer_v1
interface.description: This global provides a way to create wl_buffer objects backed by AHardwareBuffers allocated by the compositor and shared through a socket.

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: create a buffer backed by an AHardwareBuffer

request.description:
Creates a wl_buffer backed by an AHardwareBuffer.
The compositor allocates an AHardwareBuffer compatible with the requested geometry and format, then writes a small layout header and its modifier layout header and serialized AHardwareBuffer handle to socket_fd. The client imports the backing dma-buf with the reported modifier and pitch.
The format argument is the DRM fourcc of the buffer contents as read by the compositor.

arg.name: socket_fd
arg.summary: socket used for the server reply
